list.snippet: Get tested: Take a rapid antigen test or PCR test to confirm your diagnosis.
Isolate yourself: Stay home and away from others for at least 5 days after your symptoms start.
Contact your healthcare provider: Inform your doctor about your positive test and follow their instructions.

list.snippet: Get vaccinated and boosted: Vaccination is the most effective way to protect yourself from severe illness.
Wear a mask: Wear a well-fitting mask in crowded indoor settings.
